title: Control Flow Practice 2
statement:
Module 2 (Control Flow) covers: update and delete, joins, aggregate functions, subqueries, constraints and keys, indexes. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (JOINs).
hints: Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
